questions.question: Shekhar walked a distance at a speed of 8 km/h. He was in a hurry, so on the return journey he travelled in an autorickshaw at a speed of 24 km/h. Find his average speed for the entire journey.
questions.solution:
Given: 

Shekhar walked a distance at a speed of 8 km/h. 

While returning he travelled in an autorickshaw at a speed of 24 km/h. 

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

Average Speed = {Total Distance over Total Time}

Calculation:

Let the distance covered by the round-trip journey by Shekhar be (D + D) i.e. 2D km.

Time taken while going toward the destination = {D over 8} hours

Time taken while returning back from the destination = {D over 24} hours

Hence, his average speed = {2D over {D over 8} + {D over 24}} = 12 kmph

**∴ His average speed for the entire journey was 12 kmph.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Let the distance between his starting point and the destination be 24 km.

Time taken while going toward the destination = {24 over 8} hours = 3 hours

Time taken while returning back from the destination = {24 over 24} hours = 1 hour

Hence, his average speed = {24 × 2 over (3 + 1)} = 12 kmph

∴ His average speed for the entire journey was 12 kmph.

Average Speed Formula

The general formula is Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time, used when speeds or distances vary.

Harmonic Mean for Equal Distance

When a journey is divided into n equal distance parts with speeds v₁, v₂...vₙ, average speed is the harmonic mean of these speeds.

If two equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Equal Time

questions.question: A truck travels from city A to city B at an average speed of 60 km/hr. The journey takes 30 hours. He returns from city B to city A on the same road at an average speed of 40 km/hr. What was the average speed of the truck during the entire journey?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When the same distance is covered back and forth, the average speed is independent of time.

Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 60 × 40) ÷ (60 + 40)

⇒ Average Speed = 4800 ÷ 100 = 48 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 48 km/h.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed from City A to City B = 60 km/h

Time from City A to City B = 30 hours

Return speed from City B to City A = 40 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 
 
 City A
 
 
 
 City B

 Forward: 60 km/h, 30 h

 
• 
 

 Return: 40 km/h
 
 

 One-way Distance = 1800 km

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance from City A to City B = 60 × 30 = 1800 km

⇒ Since the truck returns on the same road, Return Distance = 1800 km

⇒ Time taken to return = Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Time taken to return = 1800 ÷ 40 = 45 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 1800 + 1800 = 3600 km

⇒ Total Time = 30 + 45 = 75 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 3600 ÷ 75 = 48 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 48 km/h.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

When a certain distance is covered at speed x and the same distance is covered at speed y, the Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Three Equal Distances

When three equal distances are covered at speeds x, y, and z, the Average Speed = 3xyz ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Average Speed for Different Distances

When different distances d₁, d₂, d₃... are covered at speeds s₁, s₂, s₃..., the Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = (d₁ + d₂ + ...) ÷ (t₁ + t₂ + ...).
</p

questions.question: A person drives a car for 4 hours at the speed of 75 kmph and for next 6 hours at the speed of 90 kmph. Find the average speed of the car during the entire journey.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

He drives for 4 hours at the speed of 75 kmph

He drives for 6 hours at the speed of 90 kmph

**Concept:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation:**

Total distance = 4 hours × 75 kmph + 6 hours × 90 kmph = 300 km + 540 km = 840 km

Total time = 4 hours + 6 hours = 10 hours

 Average speed = 840 km / 10 hours = 84 kmph

**Therefore, the average speed of the car during the entire journey is 84 kmph.**

questions.question: A person completes 80 km of a journey at 10 km/h and the remaining 70 km in 7 hours. His average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A person completes 80 km of a journey at 10 km/h and the remaining 70 km in 7 hours

Formula used:

Average speed = total distance/total time

Calculation:

Average speed = total distance/total time

Total distance = 80 + 70

= 150 km

Total time = (80/10) + 7

= 8 + 7 = 15 hours

Average speed = 150/15

= 10 km/hr.

∴ The average speed is 10 km/hr
